title: Scenario Engine
tagline: SCENARIO: hedera-harness runs native multi-actor Hedera plans and checks the public mirror

prizes.placement: Open Source — Improve the Hedera Harness
prizes.title: Open Source — Improve the Hedera Harness

description:
This is an open-source improvement to hedera-dev/hedera-harness, the CLI that drives a coding agent to build Hedera apps and then decides whether the work passed.

The harness already had CHAIN: one throwaway testnet wallet injected into the generated app. That is the wrong layer for two-party transfers, HTS airdrops, or HCS messages. People were left hoping Playwright clicked Transfer, or trusting a toast after the agent wrote 40 to 80 lines of SDK boilerplate. A toast is not proof. The agent does not get to grade itself.

This project adds SCENARIO, an opt-in fifth stage. You write a short YAML plan with named actors (alice, bob), steps (transfer HBAR, create a token, associate, airdrop, create an HCS topic, submit a message), and asserts. The harness funds those actors from your testnet operator, sends real transactions with the official @hiero-ledger/sdk, then polls the public testnet mirror until the effects are visible: Bob's HBAR, Bob's token balance, the topic text. The coding agent does not run this and does not declare success.

Stage order is GENERATE, ASSERT, SCENARIO, SMOKE, EVALUATE. A failed native plan skips the browser, so you do not pay for Playwright when the chain work already failed. A mirror or SDK outage is treated as infrastructure, not as an app failure.

There is also hedera-harness validate-scenario, which runs the plan alone with no agent. That is the demo path. Testnet only. Mainnet is rejected. Actor keys are never committed.
how_its_made:
Built in TypeScript on top of hedera-harness 2.0 (schema v3, their dev branch). The new code lives in src/scenario/: a YAML plan parser, operator env reuse from chainValidation, real AccountCreate / AccountDelete for named actors, an executor that uses the @hiero-ledger/sdk already shipped with the CLI, and a small REST client that polls https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com for HBAR balances, token balances, topic messages, and pending airdrops.

Steps map to real SDK transactions: TransferTransaction, TokenCreateTransaction, TokenAssociateTransaction, TokenAirdropTransaction, TokenClaimAirdropTransaction (PendingAirdropId built from the mirror, not a fake fromString), TopicCreateTransaction, TopicMessageSubmitTransaction. Later steps can refer to earlier ones by id (token: gold, topic: chat).

The stage is wired into attemptStages so it runs after ASSERT and before SMOKE. sessionRunner provisions actors once per run and sweeps leftover HBAR at the end (best effort: a token treasury cannot be deleted). doctor checks operator env and plan shape. CLI help and validate-scenario call the same executor as a full run. harnessGit treats scenario-actors.json as a secret.

No in-process fake ledger. No simulated consensus. Tests cover plan parsing, recipe load (inline and file:), mainnet rejection, CLI wiring, and cleanup of actor keys. Docs are in docs/scenarios.md plus the README stage table. The skeleton ships a two-actor HBAR / HTS / HCS example.
auto_summary: This project extends the Hedera Harness CLI with a YAML-driven scenario stage that executes and verifies real Hedera testnet actions.
